notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/65dc67f0318e1b9a3a0491e71ac2dbb0242d9b09.png[/img]

Today, during the maintenance, the following changes were made to the game:

- the rewards for the pieces of the puzzles "Well", "Oak" and "Bedroom" have been changed (numbered pieces have been replaced with universal ones).
- the drop of pieces of these puzzles in the rooms has also been replaced from numbered to universal ones.
- quests for collecting the missing pieces of these puzzles have been added (for those who have not yet completed the puzzle).

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update news
Update news
notes.content:
⭐Update News⭐
We continue to work on improving the mobile version of the game. In the current update:
- The room challenge interface has been changed. Searching for items is now even more convenient!
- Added a safe indicator, next to friends' avatars.
- Decors in player rooms are now loaded correctly the first time.
- Special promotional offers have been added
⚡We're waiting for you, at the Puppeteer's mansion!⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/4339732ae1a8b1d7fc356cb37a071472c1b16bd2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update news
Update news
notes.content:
⭐Update news⭐
Today's update has included bug fixes. Now the game runs stably on devices with any resolution.
We continue to work on optimization. We are optimizing the mansion rooms to make the game run faster.
⚡Try the new changes today⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/4339732ae1a8b1d7fc356cb37a071472c1b16bd2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update news
notes.content:
⭐Update news!⭐
We are continuing to work on the interface. This time we have improved the puzzle window. Now it's a pleasure to collect them!
Let's say goodbye to unnecessary clicks! Now, after passing the test in the room, the completion window will close on the first press of the button.
We also fixed the tips for the new diary pages. They will now display correctly for players of all levels.
We also paid attention to the error in which some players could not enter the game. We have made changes to help players with this issue.
⚡Don't miss out on the new items in the Puppeteer Mansion!⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/4339732ae1a8b1d7fc356cb37a071472c1b16bd2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update news
notes.content:
⭐Update news!⭐
A new update is already in the game!
- We have fixed the day fountain! You can now enter this sunny area to complete your challenges.
- We have fixed the issue when you couldn't open your quest journal via the pop-up window. Your active quests are now easily accessible!
- No more empty diary! Its pages are now correctly displayed and other characters' notes won't disappear.
- The patchnote window is now reworked. It's now larger and more convenient. All the news is posted there so you don't miss new events!
⚡Hurry up to unravel the Puppeteer's mysteries!⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/4339732ae1a8b1d7fc356cb37a071472c1b16bd2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update news
notes.content:
⭐Update news!⭐
We have prepared a number of changes which will improve the gameplay:

⚡Hurry up and experience new changes right now!⚡

notes.title: Beltane!
🔱The "Wonders of the world" event has started! 🔱
notes.content:
🔱The "Wonders of the world" event is already in the game! 🔱

The time of change is coming! The Monolith appeared at the mansion, and it's time to unravel mysteries!

We reworked the event to make it better and more interesting for you:
• Changed the amount of items required for event's completion
• Added new rewards for combining event items
• Added new packs for those who are eager to speed up the progress
• Updated the event description

It's time to dive into the exciting world of history and archeology! New adventures, unique decors and a fun furry friend are waiting for you! 🐾
✨Welcome to the game! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/369229ee2b01e9f404adfab87046601da3444d0f.png[/img]

notes.title: ✨New "Wonders of the world" event!✨
notes.content:
🔱The "Wonders of the world" event is already in the game! 🔱

The time of change is coming! The Monolith appeared at the mansion, and it's time to unravel the Great Pyramids' mysteries! But something has changed!

We reworked the event to make it better and more interesting for you:
• Changed the amount of items required for event's completion
• Added new rewards for combining event items
• Added new packs for those who are eager to speed up the progress

It's time to dive into the exciting world of history and archeology! New adventures, unique decors and a fun furry friend are waiting for you! 🐾
